prompts.title: Women’s Empowerment
prompts.prompt:
Create a high-end promotional poster for International Women’s Day, designed like a luxury editorial campaign combining professional studio photography with modern graphic design. Strictly use the uploaded reference image for strong face and identity matching, preserving the exact facial structure, proportions, skin tone, hairstyle, and natural expression so the subject remains clearly recognizable.
Composition & Framing
The subject occupies 30-40% space of the frame.
Vertical 4:5 poster composition with a carefully balanced editorial layout.
The subject is positioned slightly left of center, leaving visual space on the right for the large symbolic element and maintaining strong poster balance.
The camera captures a three-quarter seated portrait (mid-thigh framing) rather than a full-body shot, ensuring the subject remains the primary focus while still showing the relaxed seated posture.
The subject sits comfortably in a modern plush red velvet armchair, angled slightly toward the camera.

Pose Details
The pose is relaxed, confident, and natural:
• The subject sits upright but comfortably

• Her back rests gently against the chair

• Right leg crosses over the left leg in a natural seated posture

• Her hands rest softly on her knee, fingers relaxed and elegant

• Shoulders relaxed with a confident posture
Her head is slightly tilted toward the camera, with a warm, natural smile that conveys confidence, inspiration, and positivity.
Subject Appearance
A confident woman with natural wavy hair cascading over one shoulder.
Hair has soft studio shine and natural movement.
She wears a minimalist elegant white pantsuit:
• tailored white blazer

• matching white trousers

• clean white blouse underneath
The white suit creates strong visual contrast against the red environment, emphasizing empowerment and elegance.
Chair Placement
The red velvet armchair sits slightly angled toward camera left, with visible soft velvet texture and rounded armrests.
The chair color blends harmoniously with the red background while still remaining distinct through lighting and fabric texture.
Background & Symbolic Element
Behind the chair, slightly to the right side of the frame, stands a large transparent acrylic/glass sculpture shaped like the number “8”, symbolizing March 8th.
The number 8 is nearly as tall as the seated subject, acting as a major graphic element.
The structure has clear reflective edges and soft studio reflections.
It is decorated with lush flowers arranged organically along the curves:
• deep red roses

• soft pink peonies

• delicate light pink blossoms

• natural green leaves
The flowers cluster mainly along the middle and lower curves of the number 8, creating a natural decorative composition.
Background Environment
A rich monochromatic red studio environment.
The wall and floor blend seamlessly into a smooth red gradient, creating a modern luxury editorial backdrop.
The floor subtly reflects light, helping anchor the chair and subject.
Typography Layout
Elegant modern poster typography integrated into the composition.

Top Left Statement
Clean uppercase white text aligned left:
“SHE IS STRENGTH,

COURAGE, AND

INSPIRATION

EVERY DAY”
Minimalist sans-serif font.
Lower Headline Section
Above the main title:
“HAPPY INTERNATIONAL WOMEN’S DAY”
Small uppercase typography.
Main Title
“WOMAN”
Very large bold white block letters, spanning across the lower portion of the poster.
Overlaying this headline is a stylized red handwritten script “Woman”, diagonally crossing the block typography for a modern graphic effect.
Bottom Text
Centered minimalist text:
“08 . MARCH”
Wide letter spacing with elegant simplicity.
Lighting
Professional studio lighting setup.
• soft frontal key light for smooth skin tones

• gentle side fill light to avoid harsh shadows

• subtle rim light outlining the subject and chair
The glass number 8 catches highlights along its edges, emphasizing transparency.
Visual Effects
Add subtle cinematic prism lens flares / rainbow light leaks appearing in the corners and lower foreground of the poster.
These soft rainbow reflections enhance the editorial luxury aesthetic.
Textures & Detail
Highly detailed materials:
• velvet fabric of the red armchair

• reflective transparent glass of the number 8

• soft natural petals and leaves of the flowers

• smooth tailored texture of the white suit
Depth of Field
The subject and the floral number 8 are sharp and detailed, while the red studio background fades into a soft gradient blur, creating subtle depth.
Style & Rendering
Luxury advertising poster aesthetic.
Photorealistic studio photography combined with high-end digital compositing and graphic design.
Vibrant cinematic color grading, polished editorial finish.
8K ultra-high resolution, professional poster design, vertical 4:5 aspect ratio.
No repeated titles.

bold uppercase clean typography

thin-line floral illustrations (leaves and petals)
slightly darker purple outlines

soft diffused light on the face
gentle shadows for depth
visible catchlight in the eyes
subtle glow halo around the subject to separate her from the background

pale lavender
lilac
orchid
deep plum / dark purple

subject centered
neon arms balanced on both sides
top text arched above
ribbon banner centered below

Modern social media campaign poster, clean graphic design, professional commercial photography, subtle glow effects, empowering aesthetic.

Quality: Ultra-high 8k resolution, sharp details, cinematic realism
Mood: Patriotic, heroic, proud, emotional

face mismatch, different person, altered facial features, beautified face, smooth plastic skin, anime face, cartoon, illustration, painting, CGI look, over-stylized face, unrealistic skin, incorrect uniform, distorted hands, extra fingers, bad anatomy, low resolution
